tools.name: get_usage_overview
tools.title: Usage overview
tools.description: Session statistics for the AVA experience: sessions played, durations, characters called, film seen or not seen, endings, handoffs and voice modes, grouped by environment and by day. Reads session metadata only, never conversation content.

tools.name: get_llm_costs
tools.title: Model usage and costs
tools.description: Language-model usage statistics: calls, tokens and cost grouped by model, feature and day, with a success or error breakdown. Reads the usage log only, never conversation content.

tools.name: get_voice_latencies
tools.title: Voice latencies
tools.description: Voice pipeline timing statistics: speech-to-text, text-to-speech first byte and total, audio playback, plus per-turn retrieval, model and validation timings as count, mean, p50, p90, p95 and max.

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.title: List sessions
tools.description: Most recent game sessions as a metadata list: start and end, duration, environment, character called, film seen or not seen, voice modality, ending reason and handoff count. Conversation content is never returned.
